notes.title: 48 hours left in our Kickstarter Campaign!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42133280/66e2eb2765fe845bc32f7644b18f54ebfb3f10cb.png[/img]

[h1]My Fellow Ravens![/h1]

We're in the crucial final hours of our Kickstarter campaign!
Allow me to share some stats with all of you:

(1) The big one first: We've raised over USD [b]$105,000[/b] with the help of ~[b]2200[/b] of you (and there's still 48 hours to go!) I cannot believe the insane showing of support for our little project 🤯 truly and deeply humbled by all of your support - you have ensured that this passion project of ours will see the light of day and to that end, no amount of thanks and appreciation will ever be enough to how much it means to us. 

You are our lifeblood, and we will endeavor on. Thank you 🙇🏻

(2) we're just [b]65 discord[/b] members away from unlocking our [b]Nintendo Switch[/b] stretch goal! you can find out more about it here:

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/gatherroundstudios/the-white-raven/posts/3565578]https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/gatherroundstudios/the-white-raven/posts/3565578[/url]

if you're interested, you can help by joining us here!

[url=https://discord.gg/j57N7Y2XSX][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42133280/263732917a7a7f9cbcb69fa60236f2033df947a2.png[/img][/url]


(3) We also reached [b]2000 [/b]backers and in doing so, having unlocked [b]Brazilian Portuguese[/b] localization for The White Raven! Here's a list of languages that we're currently introducing to our game - we might add more before our 1.0 launch however!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42133280/a3d5392b54f34fe9c0ce0dc68db157dc7e55e2d6.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42133280/b5d8ab9cf2812b26054b724f9c1794de648cdb5a.png[/img]

(4) we've also decided to introduce some last minute surprise rewards for the campaign!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42133280/58ca0b42360907ceff827b8f7eb559569ece0552.jpg[/img]

First up is a [b]T-shirt[/b] design that features our main characters! Still a work in progress for now (we might end up adding all our unannounced confidants as well😉).

Unisex Sizes: 2XS – 3XL 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42133280/46f73d5ed3b821a931ae135b1050200579676fe9.jpg[/img]

Next up is an Kickstarter-exclusive [b]poster[/b] (only for backers):

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42133280/1f6f373222374541dcafd6b4d3e181cd2829e50e.jpg[/img]

Again, these are mockups and designs will be subject to change! but no worries as we'll be updating you when we've come up with the final design - we promise that it'll be look plenty awesome😎


(approx.) Dimensions: A3 (297 mm x 420 mm or 11.7 in x 16.5 in)


They're currently priced at SGD $28 (~ USD $20) for the T-shirt and SGD $10 (~ USD $7) for the poster which you can purchase when our Backerkit survey is sent out after the campaign but we'll also be introducing an exclusive tier: "The Collector's Guild" (only available during the campaign) where you can get them both at a discounted price of SGD $28! (~USD $20)


All tiers starting at "The Inner Circle" and above will also get these as an option at no extra cost as well😄

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42133280/b5d8ab9cf2812b26054b724f9c1794de648cdb5a.png[/img]

Finally we're introducing a little secret we've been working on...

[h2]Introducing the Midnight Panther pet![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42133280/3f2f2a5608d31b05a896fd468cb9cfd3ccbe36c8.png[/img]

This is a Kickstarter - exclusive pet that we've decided to introduce - the Midnight Panther!
We've been affectionately referring to her as [b]Luna[/b] - would you be interested in caring for her?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42133280/60b4f4c5e69541193e5c7a53b19aad2318b09723.gif[/img]

And of course you'd be able to name her whatever you'd like!

She'll be faithfully waiting for you in your tribe - guarding your valuables, waiting for headpats, showing you her captured prey, etc.

We'll be introducing her under a new reward called "[i]The Midnight Panther[/i]" where you can obtain your very own Luna!

Also included at no extra cost for all exclusive tiers starting at "[i]House of Hundreds[/i]" and above!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42133280/b5d8ab9cf2812b26054b724f9c1794de648cdb5a.png[/img]


Let's try our best to take off during these last 48 hours everyone! If you're interested in joining us (or just simply would like to have to have a look at some more details of The White Raven), click the [b]gif[/b] below to take a peek!


[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/gatherroundstudios/the-white-raven][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42133280/b5ed548f156db8b151bff0dca32d13d0d3a4d5cd.gif[/img][/url]


Cheers everyone, and welcome to the beginning of [i]The White Raven[/i].

- August

notes.title: Mid-campaign report!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42133280/73e2212f66d85311fdfaac03cf1f8c0789cdb6b1.gif[/img]

[h1]My Fellow Ravens![/h1]

We've just crossed the midpoint of our Kickstarter campaign. 
Here are some interesting numbers of note!:

(1) We got [u]funded in a day[/u]! Over [b]400+[/b] of you showed up on the [b]first day[/b] to make [i]The White Raven[/i] a reality, and I cannot overstate the importance of that. 
You have made all the difference. Thank you.

(2) We just smashed through [u]2 of our stretch goals[/u] with over [b]1300+[/b] of you! Minigames within the tribe and an expansion of the hidden areas of [i]The White Raven[/i] have been unlocked. Breaking through 1000 backers has also enabled us to bring [u]Japanese Localization[/u] to the game! 

(3) We just introduced new Kickstarter-exclusive [b]physical rewards[/b]! We're bringing a [b]physical artbook[/b] and [b]tarot cards[/b] ([url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/gatherroundstudios/the-white-raven/posts/3553677]more info here[/url]) into our campaign - NOTE: They will [b]never be re-introduced ever again[/b], so grab yours while you still can!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42133280/bbdc1169615503211fc859862169cac3b8646844.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42133280/778cdb4c17aa0ee228502ec6115d3504ffa99e3a.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42133280/b5d8ab9cf2812b26054b724f9c1794de648cdb5a.png[/img]



[h2]Social Goals[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42133280/d54bf757ec0653909d4d50fd479817648674f3e1.jpg[/img]

We've also decided to add some social goals that'll enable us to add additional content (that everyone will be able to enjoy!) into the game.


If you're interested to participate, click the links below!

[url=https://discord.gg/j57N7Y2XSX][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42133280/263732917a7a7f9cbcb69fa60236f2033df947a2.png[/img][/url]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1883360/The_White_Raven/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42133280/0496037cedc1d310f953cb9ece8ba79b770eb6e6.png[/img][/url]
[url=https://twitter.com/whiteravengame/status/1541813926895226882?s=20&t=Uvg6d9AeN-rKP9JMeI8nAg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42133280/46551f06bcb2120790f81d855b1b03cc7ca5bc78.png[/img][/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42133280/b5d8ab9cf2812b26054b724f9c1794de648cdb5a.png[/img]

Oh and if you're interested in our campaign (or would like to know more info on The White Raven), You can swing by our Kickstarter page by clicking the gif below.

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/gatherroundstudios/the-white-raven][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42133280/b5ed548f156db8b151bff0dca32d13d0d3a4d5cd.gif[/img][/url]


Till we meet again,
August

notes.title: We're coming to Kickstarter!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42133280/12700064adff43e7aa6cc6007fac4f76f0aa34d2.jpg[/img]

[b][h2]Greetings fellow Ravens![/h2][/b]

We're incredibly excited to announce our [b]Kickstarter campaign[/b] launch date:

[h3]We're launching on the [b]28th of June 2022[/b]![/h3]

Swing on by to grab some [u]Kickstarter-exclusive goodies[/u] (including [b]alternate outfits[/b] for your characters, [b]your very own statue[/b] in the game, etc.) or if you're just simply curious about what our game has to offer - we're providing a TON of new details.

Here's the link to our Pre-Kickstarter page if you're interested:
[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/gatherroundstudios/the-white-raven]www.kickstarter.com/projects/gatherroundstudios/the-white-raven[/url]

It's taken us a little while but we'd love for you to take a look at where we're at in development and our plans moving forward ːsteamhappyː

(oh and if you're interested in getting a [u]sneak preview[/u] of some of our [i]stretch goals[/i], you can take a look here by signing up for our [url=https://thewhiteravengame.com/mailing-list]mailing list[/url] - see you there!)



- August from GatherRound Studios
